policy: Preserve original stats, room costs, script timing and configured compatibility choices. Use an isolated fixture or an exact saved original campaign state, then ordinary simulation and real actions; never force post-action results. Compare matched turns, input and save hashes across branches/builds. Historical disputes require an original Dungeon Keeper Gold reference, not two launchers of this fork.
captureContract: Bind executable/source/config/mod order/map/script/save hashes and initial seeds.
Capture before action, immediately around each threshold, and after completion. Match interrupted save/load and uninterrupted branches.
Use selected-gameplay snapshots plus domain-specific observations where the schema omits a necessary field; equal hashes alone do not prove all simulation state.
Keep setup edits distinct from ordinary input/continuation. A free scripted cast does not qualify normal cost or mouse interaction.
Record expected changes as explicit assertions and retain failures. A smoke success cannot complete a campaign or a whole mechanic domain.

fixtures.reason: A short continuation does not cross a complete needs/payday cycle; these coupled systems define ordinary dungeon management.
fixtures.fixture: A saved low-gold dungeon just before payday with fed/hungry and housed/unhoused creatures; one branch has accessible treasury/food/lair and another deliberately blocks a route. Advance original timers, then restore access.
assertions: Hunger, health-loss cadence, eating and hunger reduction
Gold, pay owed/advanced/backpay, anger and salary completion
Lair assignment and recovery; route failure does not silently consume salary or food

fixtures.reason: Directed DIG animation does not prove mining, hauling or gold conservation. An existing functional fixture supplies a bounded starting point.
fixtures.fixture: Mark one original gold slab for digging with an ordinary Imp and reachable treasury. Follow mining, carrying, deposit and a paid room/spell action using the configured gold-per-block amount. Add a full-treasury case.
assertions: Gold conservation across block, carried gold, ground pile, hoards and dungeon total
Full storage/route behavior and subsequent recovery
No animation-driven gain/loss or duplicated deposit after save/load

fixtures.reason: Research completion changes progress, room/spell availability, physical spellbook objects and room capacity together.
fixtures.fixture: Exact save immediately before a naturally researched spell and room threshold; continue with available and full library storage, then free a slot.
assertions: Progress consumption and next research order
Unlock occurs once with a valid artifact and matching room occupancy
Full library delays creation without losing points or duplicating books after reload

fixtures.reason: Map20 starts a meaningful script event at turn150 and later waves at TIMER0 1000..1766; existing 40-turn samples do not exercise these branches.
fixtures.fixture: Use a recorded original map20 save before an actual flag-triggered final-wave timer; sample immediately before/after 150, 1000 and later wave thresholds. Do not rewrite script timings to accelerate acceptance.
assertions: Condition/trigger flags and timer counters
Exact creature party model, owner, level, target and count
No repeated one-shot waves after reload; replay observer camera does not alter script lifetime

fixtures.reason: Equal selected RNG in a short quiet interval does not cover random decisions at research placement, prison conversion or creature combat boundaries.
fixtures.fixture: Reuse exact saves from threshold fixtures and the same ordered actions across renderer and uninterrupted/reloaded branches; change only camera/UI/presentation between repeated runs.
assertions: Action/AI/player and per-thing seeds match at every sampled turn
Random outcome and created positions match
Document unsnapshotted Lua/pathfinding state instead of generalizing a match

fixtures.reason: Zero original maps have completed; starts and save/load cannot qualify progression, terminal conditions or transferred creatures.
fixtures.fixture: Use genuine pre-terminal saves for one win, one loss and one transfer-enabled original level; proceed through the actual frontend to the next level in a fully backed-up isolated session.
assertions: Victory/defeat occurs once at the right condition
Campaign score/progress and next-map selection
Transfer preserves permitted model/level/name and is consumed once; restoration protects user progress

fixtures.reason: Existing capacity work needs a natural spell-lifecycle fixture covering ownership, teleport order, pickup restrictions and loss evaluation, not just allocator stress.
fixtures.fixture: Saved late-game original state with owned/enemy/neutral creatures and hand contents; cast normally and sample countdown, first/last teleport and end. Repeat one branch with caster losing during countdown.
assertions: Configured neutral inclusion, countdown and owner/enemy teleport spacing
No stale creature identity or pickup bypass during restrictions
Capacity handling does not remove live creatures or change original defeat timing

fixtures.reason: One live slap proves delayed damage and natural hit/cower; ordinary melee/ranged damage, armour and cooldowns remain unqualified.
fixtures.fixture: Matched ordinary melee and ranged duels with original creature levels/configs, followed by a lethal outcome; record cooldown availability and save immediately before an attack resolves.
assertions: Damage, armour, health and ability timing
Identical uninterrupted/reloaded attack results
Death/corpse behavior independent of art; normal spell costs separately tested

fixtures.fixture: A normal trainer crossing one cost-frequency and one experience threshold; repeat with insufficient treasury funds.
assertions: Gold debit matches configured cost/frequency
Room efficiency, experience accumulation and level-up
Insufficient money exits training without free progress

fixtures.fixture: Normal workshop reaches one trap and one door completion, full-capacity stall and resumed work; place each item through ordinary action.
assertions: Manufacture progress consumed once
Crate object, stored/placeable counts and occupancy agree
Storage/item limits and placed-item stock remain consistent after reload

fixtures.fixture: Captured original humanoid crosses starvation/skeleton boundary; separate prisoner naturally undergoes torture conversion with matching seeds.
assertions: Original probability and timing; food/health effects
Owner, population, room capacity and replacement identity
No duplicate conversion or changed RNG after reload

fixtures.fixture: Naturally collected corpses reach configured vampire count; kill a rebirth-eligible vampire with and without an assigned lair.
assertions: Rotten corpse count, capacity, population limit and one vampire creation
Rebirth level loss, health and lair/heart fallback
No duplicated body credit or creature after reload

fixtures.fixture: One original positive recipe and an Imp sacrifice delivered by actual hand drop into the temple; save between victims.
assertions: Recipe victim/experience accumulation and reset
Reward/penalty and original Imp price reduction
No double reward after intermediate reload

fixtures.fixture: Normal scavenger draws one creature from pool and one eligible enemy, then runs out of gold; use matched saved state before transfer.
assertions: Original cost/progress, matching model eligibility and resistance
Ownership/population/pool conservation through disappear/reappear
No free continued work or duplicate transfer after reload
